name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Route 1)
expected_outcome: Message routes through Exclusive Gateway to Message Mapping 1, sets generic headers, and completes at EndEvent_2 with HTTP 202/200 OK.
validates: CallActivity_4 (Header Enrichment), ExclusiveGateway_80 routing to SequenceFlow_82, CallActivity_102 mapping execution, CallActivity_13 header logging, and EndEvent_2.

name: Sales Order Return Processing (Route 2)
expected_outcome: Message routes directly to CallActivity_71 for generic headers enrichment without mapping, terminating successfully at EndEvent_9.
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 routing to SequenceFlow_113, CallActivity_71 execution, and EndEvent_9 completion.

name: Unmatched Routing Condition - Escalation End
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with unmatched OrderTypeCode (e.g., 'UNKNOWN_TYPE')
expected_outcome: Message falls back to default route SequenceFlow_110 and terminates at EndEvent_11 with escalation code 'RoutingConditionNotMet'.
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 default path branch SequenceFlow_110 and EndEvent_11 escalation handling.

name: Exception Subprocess Trigger on Malformed XML
trigger: Inbound payload with malformed XML syntax during mapping execution
expected_outcome: Exception Subprocess 91 catches error; CallActivity_97 restores original payload from property 'InputPayload', CallActivity_100 logs the payload, and EndEvent_95 throws ErrorEndEvent.
validates: SubProcess_91 lifecycle, property retention of InputPayload, and ErrorEndEvent propagation.

name: Boundary Test - Missing Generic Metadata Headers
trigger: Inbound valid SOAP notification where environment externalized parameters (Region, Country) evaluate to empty/null
expected_outcome: Content Modifier handles empty parameter values gracefully; Groovy script Interface_Generic_Headers skips null property attachments without NullPointerException.
validates: CallActivity_4 null handling and Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy null-check branching.
